teaching_point: A coding decision begins with a decision about meaning.
added_example: For a synthetic promotion offering a travel voucher, the first question is whether the relevant source treats that voucher as a gift or as a fee discount. A program can apply either classification consistently. Consistency becomes useful only after the classification and the offer's regulatory scope have been reviewed.

teaching_point: A publication becomes a banking task through its effect on an activity.
An institution's name does not settle which regulated role it occupies.
added_example: A bank that distributes a fund and also provides a tokenised product may occupy two roles. Each role needs its own applicability assessment. A requirement imposed on the provider does not become a distributor requirement merely because both activities occur within the same group.

teaching_point: Three different denominators answer different questions.
added_example: If all 729 assignments pass, the evidence covers the chosen six-input formula. It does not supply 729 independently read legal provisions. A single omitted definition can affect every assignment simultaneously.

teaching_point: Meaning can change at each translation boundary.
added_example: A source can be read correctly while a host sends dollars into a field declared in cents. Conversely, exact arithmetic can faithfully execute a rule that omitted an exception. The investigation must locate which transition introduced the error before choosing a repair.

teaching_point: Repeated translation creates repeated opportunities for meaning to change.
Completeness needs a visible denominator.
added_example: A report saying that paragraph 10 was encoded can be accurate. A report saying that the circular was translated requires an account of all the remaining paragraphs and footnotes, including provisions outside the selected executable scope.

teaching_point: Agreement does not expose material absent from every reader's input.
The subject being classified changes the exception question.
added_example: Suppose an offer combines a fee reduction and a travel voucher. Showing that the fee reduction is a discount does not by itself classify the voucher. The adopted rule must say whether the exception attaches to each component or to the whole offer.

teaching_point: Later knowledge changes a reassessment without changing what was known earlier.
Responsibility accompanies the rule through review and use.
Wealth is one part of the selected SPI assessment.
added_example: A synthetic client with qualifying assets can satisfy the financial condition while having conservative investment objectives. The financial result remains true; the full assessment must still address the exclusion and the other conditions. Giving those two results different names prevents a wealth test from becoming a trade permission.

teaching_point: The worked change starts from a particular transaction and its evidence.
The main circular's attachments are part of the reading task.
Different owners answer different questions about the same input.
Either reviewed wealth route can establish this subcondition.
added_example: At exactly HK$40 million of qualifying portfolio and zero qualifying net assets, the inclusive portfolio route succeeds. Reducing only that portfolio by one cent makes both routes false. Replacing the alternative with a conjunction would incorrectly reject the first case.

teaching_point: Generating a candidate precedes approval of its use.
Withdrawal changes later behavior while preserving earlier decisions.
A source packet and an activity jointly define the question.
Isolating a formula must not isolate it from its qualifications.
The six inputs carry separate interpretive commitments.
added_example: A payment can be linked to the type of fund even when it is not linked to one named fund. Treating those two routes as one input would conceal the omission detected by the product-type case.

teaching_point: Paired cases isolate the condition that changes the answer.
The enumeration covers a finite abstract input space.
A meaningful mutation changes a consequential interpretation.
A cash payment's label does not establish the discount exception.
added_example: Suppose a client pays a fee of HK$100 and receives HK$100 later. Amount equality alone does not establish that the payment reduces that fee. The contractual relationship, purpose and applicable definition still matter. Those are evidence questions that another truth-table run cannot settle.

teaching_point: An investigation can finish with a useful unresolved result.
Freezing an oracle and making it independent are different steps.
Correctness has several distinct targets.
Preservation compares specified meanings across representations.
Changing the quantifier changes which offers satisfy the rule.
added_example: For two benefits, let the condition hold for the fee discount and fail for the voucher. An existential statement is true because one benefit qualifies. A universal statement is false because the voucher does not. No compiler error is needed for those readings to disagree.

teaching_point: Logical direction determines what a satisfied condition establishes.
A proof exposes the assumptions under which its conclusion follows.
An executable meaning requires decisions about inputs and operations.
Types give an expression a defined interpretation.
A sufficient known route can settle an alternative despite missing information.
added_example: The first case stays unknown because the missing portfolio could change the answer. The second establishes the financial condition through the inclusive net-asset route. Neither case treats missing portfolio evidence as zero.

teaching_point: Three-valued evaluation follows information rules, not every classical identity.
Different reasons for withholding a Boolean answer require different remedies.
Readability and precise translation meet in a restricted language.
The preservation argument follows the structure of the expression.
added_example: For an alternative of two comparisons, first establish that each comparison has the same value in both implementations. Then establish that both use the same unknown-value rule for the alternative. This local argument still needs separate treatment of errors, scope and observable traces.

teaching_point: A counterexample concerns the domain actually encoded.
Knownness prevents a placeholder from becoming evidence.
A solver turns a formal disagreement into a concrete example.
A workflow invariant needs an initial case and a transition argument.
A duty concerns events and observation completeness.
Each part of assurance needs its own evidence.
Different legal questions call for different computational languages.
Literature review must inspect the mechanism being borrowed.
Defeasible reasoning makes the exception relationship explicit.
added_example: A general fee rule and a special discount exception cannot be combined by treating every sentence as an unconditional implication. The formalization must state when the exception applies and what happens when its applicability is unknown.

teaching_point: Permission, duty and the consequence of breach are different normative relations.
Controlled English reduces freedom to improve inspectability.
A formal language and evidence that people can use it answer different questions.
Catala makes default and exception structure part of the program.
An explanation should show why the default or exception was selected.
LegalRuleML identifies context that a bare formula does not express.
Stipula models contracts through state and controlled resource movement.
A consent history is a state problem, not a permanent client flag.
The escrow example separates authorized paths through the same resource state.
added_example: For a synthetic deposit of 100 units, a complete refund and a complete transfer cannot both spend the same held deposit. Follow one transition at a time and check the remaining balance. This illustrates the resource argument; the local contract's permitted transitions determine when either path can occur.

teaching_point: A contract proof inherits the model's expressiveness and assumptions.
A Java verification model must preserve the event meaning it is meant to check.
The theorem's restrictions must survive the proposed transfer.
Amendment changes more than the text of a condition.
A normative model can record an action that was not permitted.
Different normative backends distinguish absence and negation differently.
A table needs an explicit rule for multiple matching rows.
added_example: If two rows match the same client, a first-match policy and a collect policy compute different outputs. Visual neatness does not choose between them. The bank must adopt the intended meaning before the table becomes an interchangeable backend.

teaching_point: Availability, interoperability and adoption are separate questions.
A solver can reason correctly about an incorrectly translated question.
The information supplied to a benchmark limits what its success establishes.
Roundtrip checks can expose loss, but can also repeat a shared omission.
The supporting span can lie beyond the nearest sentence.
Boundary cases test different sources of failure.
Date semantics needs explicit calendar assumptions.
added_example: For a synthetic anniversary beginning on 29 February, a non-leap year forces a policy choice. February 28, March 1 and rejection are distinct outcomes. A library default cannot establish which convention the adopted requirement uses.

teaching_point: Clause consistency and compliance of a process are different analyses.
The first implementation gives each borrowed mechanism a testable purpose.
Search explores consequential readings of the same facts.
A drafting service proposes an interpretation together with its dependencies.
A legal theory explains why the factors matter.
Case-based reasoning needs reasons for similarity and difference.
added_example: Two promotions can both involve cash yet differ because only one reduces an identified charge. The similarity in payment form does not settle the exception. A useful comparison isolates the relationship that the legal reading treats as decisive.

teaching_point: AGATHA makes rival theory construction explicit.
An objection can challenge the evidence or the step from evidence to conclusion.
added_example: An invoice may establish that a fee exists without establishing that a later payment reduces it. One objection disputes the invoice's authenticity; another accepts the invoice but disputes the inference. The workbench should preserve the distinction because the remedies differ.

teaching_point: A burden of proof concerns what support is sufficient for a proposition.
Search breadth concerns distinct meanings, not paraphrase count.
A search reward directs computation; its definition determines what is favored.
A targeted document request can separate readings that another vote cannot.
Linguistic variety and uncertainty about meaning are different quantities.
Reuse must name a concrete capability and the changed context.
Adjacent tools contribute different capabilities, each requiring local validation.
The ensemble's purpose is to investigate, not merely count votes.
The common failure creates dependence between members.
added_example: In this synthetic model, every member has error probability 0.118. Holding that probability fixed makes the independence comparison meaningful. Adding members reduces the residual joint-failure term, while the shared-failure contribution stays at 0.02.

teaching_point: Complementary responsibilities create opportunities to notice different defects.
The investigation first establishes what material its answer relies on.
Freeze initial readings before showing the preferred answer.
A discrepancy needs a classification before it needs a remedy.
Creating a child issue must not create a fresh budget.
Completion of processing is not resolution of the legal question.
The remedy must be capable of answering the actual question.
Different discrepancies have different closure requirements.
A useful investigation can correct its own initial question.
Shared causes should remain shared in the investigation graph.
A budget controls external work at the dispatch boundary.
added_example: If eleven actions have been issued under a cap of twelve, two simultaneous requests compete for one remaining slot. Only one can obtain a reservation. Counting after dispatch would allow both requests to escape the cap.

teaching_point: Repeated explanation without new evidence need not justify another round.
A fixed scheduler makes the first controller's choices reproducible.
The controller changes state through validated operations.
The termination argument depends on counting every external dispatch.
added_example: A finite action count alone does not stop a worker stuck inside one call. A wall-clock deadline and an independently enforced timeout are also needed for a bounded-duration service. The proof of a finite count and the engineering mechanism for stopping a call concern different quantities.

teaching_point: Recovery must not grant a stale worker current authority.
A repair changes both the candidate and the evidence needed for it.
A useful priority score is not automatically a probability.
The scripted omission case tests an encoding repair.
An unresolved ambiguity can survive a correctly executed investigation.
A complete report preserves both successful work and remaining uncertainty.
Unanimity is compatible with a shared missing obligation.
An operational precaution does not settle the legal interpretation.
Acceptance scenarios test specific ways the controller could hide failure.
Verification starts from the complete accepted specification.
An executable rule keeps its source and interpretation context.
The grammar permits only operators with defined type behavior.
A fact has both a validity period and a recording history.
Evidence normalization determines which values reach the evaluator.
Exact money arithmetic exposes a required rounding decision.
added_example: The quotient is 33 cents with one cent left in the numerator calculation: 100 = 3 times 33 + 1. Returning 33 cents would introduce a rounding choice. The present exact-scaling operation reports an error until a reviewed policy supplies that choice outside this operation.

teaching_point: Evaluation order is part of the specified behavior.
Array order does not choose a legal priority.
added_example: Even when two matching exceptions propose the same value, the current contract reports a conflict. The result records that the rule's exception selection is unresolved. Silently returning the shared value would hide that specified distinction.

teaching_point: Failure at different boundaries produces different evidence.
Oracle independence must identify what was independently established.
Boundary cases reveal the intended comparison operator.
A semantic mutation should remain executable enough to test meaning.
Paired scenarios expose the condition responsible for a change.
An inconsistent domain cannot support a useful equivalence conclusion.
added_example: A domain requiring an amount to exceed 100 and also be at most 100 has no admissible input. Finding no difference under those constraints says nothing about the two rules. The domain check must detect the contradiction before interpreting the comparison.

teaching_point: A property test needs a domain in which the proposed relation is valid.
The early compiler example and the later runtime have distinct scopes.
The earlier Java interface illustrates the input and output boundary.
The monetary comparison preserves meaning only if the input mapping preserves units.
The demonstration crosses the actual Java library boundary.
The current generated policy delegates to the verified runtime.
Equal Boolean results can still have unequal explanations.
Amending the source does not automatically migrate an open obligation.
An event transition describes ordered changes to the recorded arrangement.
Timing and observation completeness determine different duty outcomes.
added_example: Under this profile, the first performance is timely and the second is late. In the third case, a missing record cannot yet establish breach: the observation window may simply be incomplete. The three cases require distinct results even at the same assessment time.

teaching_point: External manifests avoid circular content identities.
A correct snapshot decision can be stale before the transaction commits.
Two individually acceptable reads can jointly exceed a HK$10m limit.
added_example: Each order sees HK$9.5 million when it ignores the other reservation. Together they produce HK$11 million. An atomic reservation or equivalent transaction protocol must prevent both from committing against the same unreserved balance.

teaching_point: The verification dossier supports a concrete release decision.
The workbench gives different participants views of the same reviewed meaning.
A bounded language makes its supported behavior inspectable.
Source identity and review identity must remain connected.
The original work packages explain the order of engineering dependencies.
A release contains evidence of meaning, behavior and authority.
A fixture file alone is not a passing test or an adjudicated interpretation.
The authoring API is separate from transaction-time Java execution.
The extension adds investigation at a defined product boundary.
Prose describing approval cannot create approval.
A run's bounds remain tied to the configuration under which it began.
Formal deduplication must preserve interpretive differences.
Transport success alone cannot resolve an issue.
An extraction correction can invalidate review without a regulatory amendment.
Coupled accounting changes belong in one transaction.
The API preserves an inspectable investigation through asynchronous work.
A review screen should make the decisive difference visible.
A model adapter has proposal authority, not release authority.
Source instructions cannot grant tool or reviewer authority.
added_example: A malicious attachment may contain a sentence asking the system to approve its own interpretation. That sentence is evidence to inspect, not an authenticated review. The server must reject an approval operation regardless of how persuasively the document requests it.

teaching_point: Implemented engineering and outstanding empirical and deployment work remain distinct.
Whole-cycle scenarios test different legitimate outcomes.
The vertical slice demonstrates the controller's specified behavior.
Engineering, empirical and deployment questions require different evidence.
The initial source families expose different failure mechanisms.
Many executions of one formula do not create many independent interpretations.
Reference construction precedes exposure to the candidate answer.
A useful corpus tests transfer and recognition of missing evidence.
The fifteen design scenarios cover different substantive questions.
The baseline ladder separates the contribution of each added mechanism.
The workflow study counts human preparation and review in every condition.
Selective risk and useful coverage need separate denominators.
added_example: In this synthetic illustration, the error rate among resolved questions is 1/40, or 2.5 percent. The fraction resolved is 40 percent; correctly resolved coverage is 39 percent if every other resolved result meets the reference standard. Reporting only one error in 100 would hide the abstention policy's effect.

teaching_point: Error direction and severity must remain visible beside average accuracy.
A finite perfect sample does not imply zero population risk.
Calibration, discrimination and transfer are different properties.
Conformal sets concern a fixed prediction problem under exchangeability.
added_example: With four calibration cases and a 90 percent target, the required rank is five. The construction therefore uses an infinite threshold and can return the entire label space. This is the honest consequence of the small sample, rather than evidence that a narrow legal answer has 90 percent reliability.

teaching_point: Stage-by-stage measurement locates where an interpretation was lost.
Usability evaluation should examine automation bias in consequential cases.
The planning relation requires positive savings on comparable changes.
added_example: For synthetic costs K = 100,000, M = 2,000 and A = 1,500 in the same currency, the break-even count is 200 comparable changes. If assisted cost rises to 2,100, this labor-saving calculation has no positive break-even point. Avoided errors would require separate evidence and valuation.

teaching_point: A favorable average cannot override a predeclared severe-error veto.
Responsibility must identify the decision each person is authorised to make.
A narrow perimeter must be enforced in the input and workflow.
Staffing assumptions constrain the scope that can responsibly be completed.
A conservative bank policy must retain its own authority and rationale.
Shadow operation gathers evidence under an authorised study.
Source monitoring starts a new review; it does not silently replace an active rule.
Actor and trigger distinctions survive a tokenisation rule change.
An amendment's impact follows dependencies, not only changed numbers.
An amendment may raise a separate question about existing arrangements.
Bitemporal replay keeps the question behind each assessment explicit.
A review queue needs an operational owner and a next action.
Different failure mechanisms require different controls.
Incident analysis follows the causal dependency of the error.
Availability failures must remain distinct from substantive false results.
A provider update can change the method without changing the JSON schema.
A release review inspects evidence for the exact proposed use.
Three review cases require three different next actions.
A useful literature record connects a mechanism to its local justification.
A development program borrows mechanisms through explicit comparisons.
An audit trail must show what was actually read for a citation.
The development sequence preserves the distinction between software evidence and bank authority.
Completion at one stage does not establish the next stage's claim.
